description: This file defines the MerchantLog entity class used for persisting merchant log entries in the system. It includes properties such as id, store, module, and log, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.
external_methods: javax.persistence.* (various methods like get, set, annotations)

classes.name: MerchantLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant log entry with mappings for persistence.
